in_marathi.name: Padmesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padmesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has lotus feet, or feet that are beautiful, pure, and auspicious. In Hindu mythology, the lotus is a sacred symbol of creation, purity, and detachment. The god Vishnu is often depicted with lotus feet.
